facts.summary: input:TouchMapper::vf2 reset (vtable slot 2): sub_5b0218 clears the 12 Multitouch pointer slots / released+pressed flag arrays at 0x019159bc and the Pointer instances at 0x019788a8; does not read `this`. Called by the game on scene/focus changes; the host calls it when the input source flips touch -> mouse so stale 'released' flags do not keep TouchMapper::tick returning 1 (Touch beats Mouse in InputHandler::tick).
facts.x86_to_arm_notes: Call only after checking that vtable[2] of the found TouchMapper object equals image+0x5b23f8+1. Plain AAPCS void f(void* this).
evidence: arm32re.py func 5b23f8 -> bl 0x5b0218 then a loop clearing bytes at 0x019159d4 and +0x18 (12 entries)
sub_5b0218 is the only writer of the +0/+0xc 'released' arrays besides Multitouch::feed (xref 15159bc)

facts.summary: Data cell: AppPlatform_Winrt vtable slot 154 = getDefaultInputMode (0x62212c). File bytes hold the relocated VA 0x00a2212d (ImageBase 0x400000 + 0x62212c + Thumb bit); at runtime the cell must equal image + 0x62212c + 1 before it is patched (PAGE_READWRITE, data only).
facts.x86_to_arm_notes: Replace with a host function `int hook(void* self)` returning 2 (Touch) on touch-only machines. Must be installed before MinecraftGame::vf27 reaches setupMappers 0x38ba44 (InputHandler ctor reads the default mode once).
